policy: Append-only destinations. Screen facts, production/reference names, game population estimates and authored regional geology remain distinct.

world.name: Halka
world.populationEvidence: Game estimate; no screen census is established.
world.description: Home of the peaceful Halkans. In Mirror, Mirror, their council refuses the Terran Empire's demands for dilithium because it could support violence. The homeworld's dilithium is established by the episode; the surrounding rich asteroid fields, neighboring worlds, population estimate and galaxy-chart placement are Vexed Mirror adaptations. The Halkans' refusal concerns their planetary deposits; the game's public mining fields are in uninhabited space.

geology.name: Halka dilithium province
geology.evidence: Authored regional extension of the Halkan homeworld's screen-established dilithium deposits.

catalog.name: Halka
catalog.notes: The Halkan homeworld and its dilithium/pacifist history come from Mirror, Mirror. No complete named orbital roster is established. Serevan and Lethan are original game names; the moon Tharn is an original namesake honoring the episode's council leader, not a claimed screen moon. Regional ore abundance, orbital layout, population estimate and appearances are game adaptations.

bodies.name: Halkan homeworld
bodies.description: The peaceful Halkans' inhabited homeworld. Their dilithium deposits are the focus of Mirror, Mirror; their council rejects mining that could enable violence. Its orbital artwork and population are game interpretations. Uninhabited regional asteroid fields are the game's mineable resource extension.

bodies.name: Serevan
bodies.description: Original Vexed Mirror survey world in Halka, a barren rocky inner neighbor. Its name and existence are game additions inspired by the system's dilithium story; no screen source establishes this planet.

bodies.name: Tharn
bodies.description: Original Vexed Mirror moon named in honor of Tharn, the Halkan council leader in Mirror, Mirror. The character is established; this moon and its namesake are game fiction.

bodies.name: Lethan
bodies.description: Original Vexed Mirror icy survey world beyond Halka's public outer mining field. The system connection is an adaptation; its name, existence and geology are not screen facts.

bodies.name: Halka primary
bodies.description: Illustrative primary placement. No unsupported spectral classification is asserted.
